hypothesis: A position-only single rotor with any 26-symbol wiring, AZ/KRY/PAL/ABS contact pairs, n=5..96, phase=1..n-1 and direction +/-1 can satisfy the 24 fixed published observations, or all except one. Full 145728 labeled domain; aggregate compatibility only.
not_excluded: Untested alphabets, periods >=97, other step sizes, multiple rotors, letter-triggered or irregular updates, transposition, shifted alignment, insertions/deletions, simultaneous error models, or alternative published observations beyond one omission. No blind recovery or candidate evidence is claimed.
schema_compatibility: The legacy schema requires a positive max_candidates ceiling. Its unused upper ceiling is 1, while the stricter limits max_decoded_candidates=0 and max_surviving_setting_outputs=0 remain binding. Actual zero candidates satisfy both. Aggregate records are separately capped at 201 and are not redefined as candidates.
resource_semantics: audit/run_bounded_agg.py; wall and aggregate CPU caps, sampled aggregate process-group RSS plus per-process RLIMIT_AS. Zero target retries.
notes: Preregistration and explicit mode clarification were published before source and the formal correctness gate. Development smoke output is DEVELOPMENT_ONLY. No target is permitted until the complete checker gate is GO and published; all output remains aggregate only. Same-model review does not provide independent-model promotion.
